settings.openchamber.defaults.field.sess: Some providers forget a conversation's cached context after a few minutes of silence, so the next message is slower and costs more. With this on, OpenCode sends a short prompt every 4 minutes while a session sits idle, for up to 30 minutes after your last message. Each request sends the entire session context to the model and may cost money or count against your subscription quota. Applies to all projects.
settings.mcp.page.advanced.codemodeDefau: Default lets OpenCode decide: Code Mode is on for most servers, but OpenCode turns it off for servers that bring their own, such as executor.sh, and asks PostHog for plain tools instead of its own Code Mode.
